kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نجتهد (form VIII)
# نَجْتَهِدُ (najtahidu) /nad͡ʒ.ta.hi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# نَجْتَهِدَ (najtahida) /nad͡ʒ.ta.hi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# نَجْتَهِدْ (najtahid) /nad͡ʒ.ta.hid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
